name: USD/JPY Fair Value Model (10Y Yield Spread OLS)
description: OLS regression model of USD/JPY on the US–Japan 10-year yield spread. Shows fair value overlay, deviation from fair value, z-score of deviation, regression scatter, and summary statistics.
source:
# USD/JPY Fair Value Model — OLS on US–Japan 10Y Yield Spread
# Model: USD/JPY = α + β × (US 10Y − Japan 10Y)
# Rolling OLS window: 252 days | Z-score window: 252 days

# ============================================================================
# DATA SOURCES
# ============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
usdjpy = src.c
ts = index().value

# US 10Y Treasury Yield (daily, ffill gaps)
us10y_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='DGS10', use_alfred=False)()
us10y = ffill(us10y_raw.result)

# Japan 10Y Government Bond Yield (monthly, ffill to daily)
jp10y_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IRLTLT01JPM156N', use_alfred=False)()
jp10y = ffill(jp10y_raw.result)

# 10Y Yield Spread = US 10Y − Japan 10Y
yield_spread = us10y - jp10y

# ============================================================================
# OLS REGRESSION: USD/JPY = α + β × yield_spread
# ============================================================================

ols = linear_fit(window=252)(x=yield_spread, y=usdjpy)
alpha = ols.intercept
beta = ols.slope
fair_value = alpha + beta * yield_spread

# Deviation from fair value (positive = overvalued vs model)
deviation = usdjpy - fair_value

# Rolling z-score of the deviation (252-day window)
dev_zscore = zscore(window=252)(deviation)

# Deviation as % of fair value
dev_pct = deviation / fair_value * 100

# ============================================================================
# CHART 1: Fair Value Overlay
# ============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='USD/JPY vs Fair Value (OLS on 10Y Yield Spread)',
    y_axis_label='USD/JPY',
    category='1. Fair Value Model',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='USD/JPY Actual', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Fair Value (OLS)', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(usdjpy, fair_value))

# ============================================================================
# CHART 2: Deviation from Fair Value (area chart)
# ============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='Deviation from Fair Value (USD/JPY − Model)',
    y_axis_label='Deviation (JPY)',
    category='1. Fair Value Model',
    area=True,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Deviation', color=Color.Red)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(deviation,))

# ============================================================================
# CHART 3: Deviation Z-Score (area chart)
# ============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='Deviation Z-Score (252-day rolling)',
    y_axis_label='Z-Score (σ)',
    category='2. Reversion Signal',
    area=True,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Z-Score', color=Color.Indigo)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='0', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=1, title='+1σ', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=2, title='+2σ', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=-1, title='-1σ', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=-2, title='-2σ', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(dev_zscore,))

# ============================================================================
# CHART 4: Regression Scatter (10Y Spread vs USD/JPY)
# ============================================================================

xy_scatter(
    title='Regression: 10Y Yield Spread vs USD/JPY',
    x_axis_label='10Y Yield Spread (US − Japan, %)',
    y_axis_label='USD/JPY',
    category='2. Reversion Signal',
    show_trend_line=True,
    series=ScatterSeriesSchema(series=[
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name='Daily Observations', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x=yield_spread, y_values=(usdjpy,))

# ============================================================================
# SUMMARY TABLE
# ============================================================================

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Fair Value Model Summary',
        row_size=7,
        col_size=1,
        row_headers=[
            'Current USD/JPY',
            'Fair Value Estimate',
            'Deviation (JPY)',
            'Deviation (% of FV)',
            'Deviation Z-Score',
            'Mean Deviation (Full Period)',
            'Std Dev of Deviation'
        ],
        col_headers=['Value'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Current USD/JPY', grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Fair Value', grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Deviation JPY', grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Deviation Pct', grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Z-Score', grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Mean Dev', grid_row=5, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Std Dev', grid_row=6, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='3. Fair Value Summary'
)(usdjpy, fair_value, deviation, dev_pct, dev_zscore, deviation, deviation)
